name: The Rady Shell at Jacobs Park

bagPolicy.summary: The Rady Shell at Jacobs Park does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Pre-paid parking is facilitated by Ace Parking, and drive-up parking may be more expensive. New parking is available at the IQHQ building north of Seaport Village.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in The Rady Shell at Jacobs Park's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at The Rady Shell at Jacobs Park varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Shuttle service, including an accessible shuttle equipped with a lift, is available from outside the Hilton Parking Garage and on Convention Center Drive, across from the Fifth Avenue Landing Lot. Every section of The Rady Shell at Jacobs Park is ADA accessible with designated seats available in all seating areas.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in The Rady Shell at Jacobs Park's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The San Diego Symphony Ticket Office is located in the west end of the Symphony Towers lobby at 750 B Street, at the NE corner of 7th Avenue and B. The Rady Shell Box Office is located at 222 Marina Park Way behind the San Diego Convention Center.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at The Rady Shell at Jacobs Park. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
